note: labels: null means not yet labeled; [] means labeled and clean. The agent must ignore the labels field.

requirements.text: The system shall allow registered users to log in with an email address and password.
The system shall lock an account after five consecutive failed login attempts.
A user session shall expire after 15 minutes of inactivity.
Search results should be returned quickly.
The system shall be user-friendly and intuitive.
Exported reports shall use the standard timeout when generation takes too long.
The system shall send a confirmation email within 60 seconds of order placement.
Administrators shall be able to deactivate user accounts as appropriate.
All passwords shall be stored using a salted hash.
The system shall handle errors gracefully.
After a successful checkout, the system shall display an order confirmation page containing the order number, the itemized total, and the estimated delivery date.
Users should be able to reset their password using a link sent to their registered email address.
The system shall support all major web browsers.
The system shall calculate sales tax at checkout based on the shipping address.
Order history shall be retained for 7 years.
The system shall process payments through the payment gateway and notify the user of the result.

labels.evidence: process payments through the payment gateway and notify the user of the result

requirements.text: Product search results shall be sorted by relevance, with ties broken alphabetically by product name.

labels.evidence: sorted by relevance, with ties broken alphabetically by product name

requirements.text: The system shall be highly available.
Customers should be able to cancel an order at any time before its status changes to Shipped.
The inventory count shall be updated in a timely manner after each sale.
The system shall comply with applicable data protection regulations.
Failed payment attempts shall be handled as described in the payment error handling section.

labels.evidence: as described in the payment error handling section

requirements.text: The admin dashboard shall show the number of orders placed in the last 24 hours, refreshed every 5 minutes.
The system shall allow users to upload a profile photo in JPEG or PNG format of up to 5 MB.
Uploaded photos shall be resized appropriately for display.
The system shall encrypt sensitive data.
When a user's session expires, the system shall redirect the user to the login page and preserve the shopping cart contents for 30 days.
The system shall support 10,000 concurrent users with a 95th percentile page load time under 2 seconds.
The admin console shall use the same inactivity timeout as user sessions.
The system shall never lose customer data.
